t: Can My S Corp Buy My House?
s: December 4, 2024 - If the S corporation buys your home to use in the business (presumably, the business function is real estate rentals), then you would not be able to live there. On the other hand, if you sell your home to your S corp, you can claim the primary residence exclusion for capital gains (up to the limits), and the S corp will have a new basis.
